### Keepers' checklist

- [ ] I read [SCENE_STANDARD.md](../SCENE_STANDARD.md).
- [ ] This is an independently authored scene or proposal; no unsolicited greeting or popup occurs on entry.
- [ ] It is strange, funny, and welcoming—not horror, combat, or a mandatory quest.
- [ ] There is no map, fast travel, fake doorway, or shortcut to an unbuilt place.
- [ ] A real return passage is planned or implemented.
- [ ] Clickable objects have keyboard-accessible alternatives, and text-only mode was considered.
- [ ] No accounts, tracking, persistent identifiers, remote AI calls, secrets, or extra third-party scripts were introduced.
- [ ] Existing scenes and residents remain intact.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (or this is a story-only proposal with no code).
- [ ] I have not merged or deployed this myself. Ryan is the final reviewer.
